page.overview:
Who is Banker with House Costume?

The Banker with House Costume is a banker in New York City. He wears a house costume which his head protrudes from as a promotion with the slogan "Our interest rates are through the roof!" When the Banker with Antlers discovered that Krusty the Clown had signed a check with a fraudulent stamp, he called this banker, who in turn called the Cayman Islands banker. It was then determined that Krusty possessed an illegal account.
